newsitem.title: USA: U.S Northwest spot prods notionally flat Thursday.
newsitem.headline: U.S Northwest spot prods notionally flat Thursday.

text.p: Spot product prices in the U.S. Northwest were notionally flat Thursday, with little direction from California markets or NYMEX .
Conventional-grade California gasoline fell a cent to 60/61 cents on Thursday, amid weak demand as refinery margins and retail prices remained poor.
Seattle conventional regular gasoline stayed notionally unchanged at 58.75/59.75 cents a gallon.
Seattle low sulphur diesel remained 72.25/73.25 cents a gallon and jet fuel was the same.
Meanwhile, December heating oil on NYMEX closed a mere 0.44 cent a gallon higher at 66.89 cents a gallon.
NYMEX front-month unleaded gasoline rose 0.17 cents to 63.80 cents.
